Linksnappy takes links under every domain of a hoster it supports. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Linksnappy fetches links under a hoster's other domains.** Linksnappy lists some hosters under a domain their links rarely use, such as mega.co.nz for Mega and ddl.to for DDownload. A mega.nz, k2s.cc, ddownload.com or rg.to link therefore looked like one no debrid account covers, and with premium only switched on it waited for a premium account. Every debrid service now recognises a hoster by all of its known domains. KnightLoader also signs in before it reads Linksnappy's hoster list, and leaves out hosters your account cannot download from. ([#68](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/68))
